game_flags.ref_home+: officials whose earlier games leaned to the home team
game_flags.ref_home-: officials whose earlier games leaned to the road team
game_flags.ref_over: officials whose earlier games went over
game_flags.ref_under: officials whose earlier games went under

team_flags.bowl5: college football team at 5 wins going for bowl-eligible 6
team_flags.dome_cold: dome team outdoors in the cold (<40F) or wind (15+ mph)
team_flags.hotseat: long losing streak + a bad record (hot seat)
team_flags.mustwin: in the race while the opponent isn't (a must-win for one side only)
team_flags.out_dome: outdoor team playing in a dome
team_flags.race: late season, in the playoff race (neither clinched nor eliminated, near the cut line)
team_flags.rest: clinched with the final games left (rest-the-starters spot)
team_flags.week3000: 3,000+ travel miles over the last 7 days
